itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The county form pages (p3 Schedule A, p7 Schedule B) say only 'See Attached' and leave every SUBTOTAL/TOTAL cell blank, so they carry no gate. The attachment prints its OWN per-page totals and all three fired: p4 rows 8818.53 = 'Page total' 8,818.53; p5 rows 6980.00 = 'Page total' 6,980.00; p6 rows 1325.70 = 'Page total' 1,325.70; and 8,818.53 + 6,980.00 + 1,325.70 = 17,124.23 = the printed 'Total Contributions'. itemized.notes: Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p7) are the county grid with a handwritten 'See Attached' and nothing else; the money is in a typed LANDSCAPE spreadsheet attachment - Schedule A on p4-p6 (3 pages with per-page totals) and Schedule B on p8. All four attachment pages must be rotated COUNTER-clockwise to read (rotating the other way renders them upside down). The Address/City/State/Zip columns are covered by a white redaction box on every Schedule A page, so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout - a redaction, not an empty column. Occupation and Employer are separate columns with no schema field and are preserved verbatim per row. TWO contributions carry the in-kind marker INSIDE the amount cell ('$500.00- In Kind' UPEA, '$450.70- In kind' Jenny Wilson) and both reappear as same-amount expenditure rows on Schedule B, which carries no in-kind marker of its own. One date is printed 9/16/2020 on a 2010 report (Teamsters Local 222 DRIVE Chapter) - a well-formed filer typo, kept verbatim. Both sides reconcile EXACTLY and all three page-total gates fire.
